scope: Miao Chapter 10 (pp. 327-346): the Kalman filter (as linear least-squares projection) with Examples 10.1.1-10.1.4 and the stationary filter, hidden Markov chains and the Hamilton filter, control problems with beliefs as the state (Example 10.2.1), linear-quadratic control under partial information, and Exercises 1-6.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 10
